content:
Since I don’t retain memory between conversations, I can’t recall past interactions with you. Each chat starts fresh—so if you’ve asked me something before, I won’t remember it unless you reference it in the current conversation.

If you’d like, you can share details from previous chats, and I’ll help you reconstruct or analyze how you phrased things! Otherwise, I’m happy to start anew. How can I assist you today?
